name: Hylaeochampsa
sum: Crocodylomorph from the Early Cretaceous of the Isle of Wight, known only from a short, wide partial skull.
holotype: BMNH R 177, a partial skull from the Vectis Formation (Wealden Group), Isle of Wight.
biology: The short, wide skull has a eusuchian-like palate and inferred enlarged posterior teeth suited to crushing.
author: Owen 1874

sources.text: Clark, James M. 1992. The Early Cretaceous crocodylomorph ''Hylaeochampsa vectiana'' from the Wealden of the Isle of Wight. American Museum Novitates(3032).
